card.name: Words inside all-caps warning text
card.fires_on: Words in ALL-CAPS boxed-warning style text, especially the end of CIDOFOVIR and small words like EACH, THE, PER, SINGLE inside such warnings.

modes.label: Cidofovir in caps
modes.description: The ending of the drug name CIDOFOVIR or the word INJECTION in capitalized warnings.

modes.label: Small words in caps warnings
modes.description: Short linking words such as THE, PER, EACH, SINGLE inside capitalized warning sentences.
modes.example: IF AN ALLERGIC REACTION TO CEFADROXIL MONOHYDRATE OCCURS, DISCONTINUE<< THE>> DRUG.

card.plain: It lights up on words inside capitalized boxed-warning sentences, notably the drug name cidofovir.
